cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — brushes her hair with a hairbrush; a Han-era inn — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; a quiet modern textile studio with a small table loom in warm morning light — she retrieves a dropped wooden shuttle from the low shelf beneath the loom; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — standing; a small sunlit kite-repair workshop with bamboo frames and colourful paper on a workbench — she balances a newly repaired crescent-shaped paper kite on one fingertip to test its centre of gravity; the cushioned foredeck of a moored yacht — standing; a misty enchanted garden of moss — standing; a Three Kingdoms film-set street — standing; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — standing; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — kneeling on the ground; a quiet library reading room with tall bookshelves — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height
